name: yt-dlp
provides: Download a video or its audio from a link, for editing or transcripts
asks: never: downloads land in its own folder
note: Needs python3. A dated build of yt-dlp, checked against its checksum: the stable release falls behind the sites it reads, so the pin moves to a newer build when one does.
migrationDebt: Raw tool installation/execution and third-party SDK ownership must move to published BYOKit capabilities; this manifest records current behavior, not an approved bypass.
